tweets.text:
Some honest thoughts after actively using @Nemesisdottrade V1 Testnet for the past couple of weeks 🧪

what stands out the most:
- the OMM concept isn't just marketing — it actually works smoothly in practice, being able to swap, long, and short from the same liquidity pool feels seamless
- UI/UX is clean, intuitive, and one of the most pleasant i've used in the margin trading space ✨
- the ability to open positions on almost any token that has spot liquidity is genuinely powerful and opens up new trading opportunities 

the team is clearly building something with real substance, the foundation they're creating feels solid and forward-thinking

this has serious potential to become one of the most important protocols in onchain trading.

excited to see what comes next 🔥
